findings.problem: barco-boat is prompted as "boat", and its picture will likely show a small boat, which in German is das Boot, not das Schiff; nave-ship means mainly a spaceship, so no Spanish card means exactly ship.

back.target: ship (a large vessel for sea or river travel)
back.example: The ship departs at eight o'clock.

note: The trick is a bit loose, because Schiff sounds like ship with the p swapped for an f rather than with an f added at the end; it could read "SCHIFF sounds like \"ship\" with an f instead of the p: a big ship sailing off."
